name: intel
description: Ten evidence-led intelligence workflows for research, strategy, diagnosis, foresight, innovation, risk, and decision making. Includes reusable methods and optional private source retrieval.

interface.shortDescription: Research deeply. Challenge assumptions. Decide clearly.
interface.longDescription: Turn complex questions into defensible decisions with ten coordinated workflows: research, diagnosis, competitive strategy, stakeholder intelligence, forecasting, innovation, risk, adversarial review, and decision briefs. Includes an intelligence coordinator, evidence standards, reusable templates, source-retrieval utilities, and a reference bibliography. Bring your own documents and use the research tools available in your host. Third-party source documents are not redistributed.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this decision thoroughly. Compare the strongest explanations, cite the evidence, and recommend what I should do.
Analyze this company or market: competitive forces, stakeholder incentives, emerging risks, and opportunities others may be missing.
Challenge my thesis. Find the best counterevidence, test the assumptions, and tell me what would change your conclusion.
